name: wildjailbreak-100k-repeated-seeds

wildjailbreak-100k.official_eval_limit: Upstream evaluation omits vanilla requests; exact text overlap removed, underlying-request overlap cannot be checked.
wildjailbreak-100k.split_method: 70/15/15 hash of normalized vanilla request; train capped by text hash

mlp.representation: hashed word 1-2 and character 3-5 TF-IDF, 32768 features; IDF fitted only on train
mlp.hashing_limit: Hash collisions are possible; n-gram vocabulary differs from the small-corpus baseline.

smoke_policy.purpose: save/resume verification only; excluded from experiment rankings

resume_policy: same configuration, code hashes, data hashes, and protocol; optimizer-update boundaries
